reviewers.summary: The production classification now depends only on the normalized target URL, and the named test covers non-production labels without approval. No defect was found in the reviewed changes.
The prior environment-label bypass is fixed. Path normalization still lets an encoded slash qualify for the no-approval synthetic-target exemption.

findingList.message: A01:2025 Broken Access Control: decoding reserved path characters lets a non-equivalent URL match the synthetic-target exemption. Preserve encoded reserved characters during normalization or reject this form.

evidence.codePathTraced: _production_target exempts a target when its normalized URL equals the synthetic target. _normalized_target_url decodes every percent escape in the path before comparing it.
evidence.failureScenario: A caller supplies https://ingest.example/api%2fv1 with an API key and no isolation approval. The encoded slash is decoded to /api/v1, so the function returns a config even though the request URL may address a different path than the exact synthetic target.

reviewers.summary: The change addresses the prior environment-label bypass. However, decoding reserved path characters during target classification can exempt a URL that is not the exact synthetic target.

findingList.message: A01:2025 Broken Access Control: decoding the reserved encoded slash can classify a non-equivalent target as the synthetic test URL and bypass isolation approval. Preserve reserved path characters during normalization or reject this encoding.

evidence.codePathTraced: _normalized_target_url decodes reserved path characters before comparing the target with the synthetic URL. _production_target then exempts a URL whose decoded path matches that synthetic path.
evidence.failureScenario: A caller supplies https://ingest.example/api%2fv1 without isolation approval. The encoded slash is decoded to /api/v1 for classification, so configuration is returned. A downstream HTTP client or proxy that preserves or interprets the encoded slash differently can route the request to a path other than the exact synthetic test target.
